items.t: Oklahoma Sports Hall of Fame and Jim Thorpe Association Proudly Reveal the 2026 Paycom Jim Thorpe Award Finalists
items.sum: OKLAHOMA CITY, November 24, 2026--Oklahoma Sports Hall of Fame and Jim Thorpe Association today released the finalists for the 2026 Paycom Jim Thorpe Award. This list includes the nation’s three best defensive backs based on performance on the field, athletic ability and character.
